measuredBehavior.members: char[] default0, Set/Get/index/Length(dim), NUL/BMP chars, wrapper/backing aliases survive live and external resume.
measuredBehavior.UTF16: Conversions preserve raw surrogate code units and NUL live. BinaryWriter.Write(char) rejects surrogate elements; string migration replaces lone D800 with FFFD while paired surrogate survives.
measuredBehavior.empty: Live empty char[] converts to empty string; externally normalized null backing makes xmrChars2String throw ArgumentNullException(value). Zero-count xmrString2Chars avoids source/backing access.
measuredBehavior.faults: Wrong Int32[] backing fails cast even count0; null wrapper/null source count1 fail NullReference; out-of-range partial string copy retains already written A,Z cells.
measuredBehavior.mixed: Source with integer[] and char[] has distinct generated class indices and resumes to result83.

boundaries: Fourteen bounded actual source cases per OS:13 complete migration snapshots plus1 observed production write fault; no native execution/parity claim.
Exact fault messages preserved per OS, including platform newline differences.
No forced GC or GC-cause claim.
